label: Wolffsohn 2000
setting: low vision clinic (Vision Australia Foundation; Melbourne)
diagnosis_mix: NR (conditions listed in Table 4 p8 as ARMD, glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, other, multiple; counts not given)
recruitment: 515 consecutive first-time patients of a low-vision clinic sent the LVQOL before appointment; 65% returned pre, 83% of those returned post; 278 returned both (Table 2 p7)
notes: Development/validation and responsiveness study, no sens/spec. Age 78 +/- 11 and 34% male are for the 278 who returned both questionnaires (Table 2 p7); pct_female = 100 - 34 derived. Item-selection sample: 150 low vision patients (p3); normal-vision control group 70 (age 68.3 +/- 10.5, 39% male; p5). Administration by post, phone or in-person interview (p3). Completion time 5 to 10 minutes (p9). Best-corrected distance VA 0.56 +/- 0.34 logMAR in the 278 (Table 2 p7).
